content.title: ‘The Pitt’ Season 2 Release Schedule—When Do New Episodes Come Out?
content.text: Robby walks in on Al-Hashimi’s training session; He welcomes her to The Pitt. Warrick Page/MAXHBO’s award-winning medical drama The Pitt is back for Season 2. If you’ve already watched the premiere, here’s everything you need to know about when new episodes arrive on HBO Max, how many episodes the season includes, the release schedule and more.The second season continues to follow Dr. Robby (Noah Wyle) and his team of doctors and nurses in the overcrowded emergency department of the fictional Pittsburgh Trauma Medical Hospital. Many health professionals have praised the first season for its remarkable accuracy, and ER physicians even invited Wyle to their annual conference this fall.There is a 10-month time jump between Seasons 1 and 2, which gave the writers “a lot of room to develop “a few stories in the interim and catch up with everyone,” series creator R. Scott Gemmill told TVLine in April 2025.ForbesWhat Time Does ‘The Pitt’ Season 2 Premiere Tonight? Here’s How To WatchBy Monica MercuriSeason 2 will continue with the show’s unique format, with one episode covering one hour of a grueling shift for hospital staff. This time, the show will take place over the Fourth of July weekend, and viewers should expect fireworks-related injuries and more.MORE FOR YOU“There are all sorts of creative accidents that happen on the Fourth of July,” Wyle told Deadline in December. “You’ve got fireworks, you’ve got motor sports, you’ve got water sports, you’ve got all sorts of stuff going on.”The second chapter has been earning rave reviews from critics so far, and the season already boasts an impressive 98% score on Rotten Tomatoes. USA Today critic Kelly Lawler called The Pitt “the absolute best show on television," writing in her review: “The themes are powerful and gut-wrenching. You won’t want to − or even be able to − look away. And that’s all we can ask for from our TV shows.” Email Address When Do New Episodes Of The Pitt Season 2 Come Out?Langdon asks Whitaker to drain ﬂuid from Louie.Warrick Page/MAXNew episodes of The Pitt Season 2 are released every Thursday at 9 p.m. ET / 6 p.m. PT on HBO Max.How Many Episodes Are In Season 2 Of The Pitt?Robby walks in on Al-Hashimi’s training session; He welcomes her to The Pitt. Warrick Page/MAXThe second season of The Pitt will have 15 episodes, the same number as the first season. Each episode covers one hour of a 15-hour workday for the hospital workers over Independence Day weekend.What Is The Pitt Season 2 Release Schedule?Robby and the battling savants try and diagnose DKA Orlando. Warrick Page/MAXFollowing the Jan. 8 premiere, new episodes of The Pitt will be available Thursday evenings starting at 9 p.m. ET on HBO Max. The remaining episodes will be released weekly until the Season 2 finale, currently slated to air on April 16, 2026.Check out the full release schedule for The Pitt Season 2 below.Episode 1 (Premiere) — Airing Jan. 8, 2026Episode 2 — Airing Jan. 15, 2026Episode 3 — Airing Jan. 22, 2026Episode 4 — Airing Jan. 29, 2026Episode 5 — Airing Feb. 5, 2026Episode 6 — Airing Feb. 12, 2026Episode 7 — Airing Feb. 19, 2026Episode 8 — Airing Feb. 26, 2026Episode 9 — Airing Mar. 5, 2026Episode 10 — Airing Mar. 12, 2026Episode 11 — Airing Mar. 19, 2026Episode 12 — Airing Mar. 26, 2026Episode 13 — Airing Apr. 2, 2026Episode 14 — Airing Apr. 9, 2026Episode 15 (Finale) — Airing Apr. 16, 2026How To Watch The Pitt Season 2They all watch Trauma I, discuss Kylie's diagnosis & Pitt PD wants to talk. Warrick Page/MAXThe Pitt is exclusively streaming on HBO Max. To watch the second season and previous episodes, you’ll need to sign up for a subscription to the streaming service. HBO Max currently offers three subscription plans: Basic with ads for $10.99 per month, Standard for $18.49 per month, and Premium for $22.99 per month. There is no free trial offered at this time.Watch the first-look trailer for The Pitt Season 2 below.
